description: DAO-COLL/DAO-DRAFT on a writable copy: on Parent (five rows), a Required Long field ZReq (no default), an optional Long ZOpt and a Text field ZTxt (size 10, AllowZeroLength True) are appended one after another. After each: Fields Count, then each Field's Name, OrdinalPosition, Required and AllowZeroLength. Then Refresh and the same reads; then a snapshot of ID, ZOpt, ZTxt is read.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
